FullStack Engineer

MeGaDev
$$$$

We are looking for a strong FullStack Engineer with hands-on experience in TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS and AWS to develop, support and modernize a production platform.

Key responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain services using TypeScript, NestJS and Node.js
  • Work with AWS and microservices
  • Analyze and modernize legacy systems
  • Perform reverse engineering and troubleshooting
  • Support production systems and handle incidents
  • Work with DevOps, monitoring and observability
  • Improve system performance and reliability
  • Support selected React / Fullstack tasks
  • Contribute to architecture and technical improvements

Nice to have: AWS Serverless, event-driven architecture, SRE, AI-assisted development, FinTech/Accounting experience.

Required languages

English B2 - Upper Intermediate
TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js, AWS, DevOps
